gui.molecularmanipulator.sequence_batch_: Click processes 1 item; Shift-click processes up to 64.

gui.molecularmanipulator.sequence_rewrit: Place one real item in the center sample slot before enabling copying. The sample is kept but must remain physically installed; removing or changing it stops copying.
gui.molecularmanipulator.rewrite_output_: Choose whether copied items enter ME or only the output slot. A full selected destination stops copying.
gui.molecularmanipulator.matter_target_t: Set the number to process before stopping. 0 means unlimited.

gui.molecularmanipulator.visual_color_ad: Click to add 17; Ctrl-click for a fine step of 1; Shift-click to subtract.

message.molecularmanipulator.sequence_bl: Place one output sample in the central blueprint slot.

molecularmanipulator.configuration.title: %s Configuration
molecularmanipulator.configuration.patte: Sets the number of pattern pages available to each Sequence Array. Each page contains 36 pattern slots. Range: 1-1000; default: 20.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.build: Maximum structure blocks placed or removed per tick. Higher values finish faster but increase instantaneous server load. Range: 1-256; default: 32.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.idle_: Idle power used by the Sequence Array controller while connected. Range: 1-4096 AE/t; default: 128 AE/t.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.max_c: Maximum amount allowed in one AE2 autocrafting request. Amounts above 2147483647 use the long-integer request path. Default: 1000000000000. Extreme values can still exceed intermediate arithmetic limits in complex AE2 recipes.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.omni_: SAFE compiles deterministic AE2 recipe subtrees, merges repeated requests, and calculates them in topological batches. Unsupported, fuzzy, substituting, container-returning, multi-pattern, or recursive branches automatically fall back to AE2. OFF disables this optimization.
Maximum unique recipe nodes compiled per calculation before falling back to AE2. Range: 64-65536; default: 8192.
Maximum time spent compiling the safe recipe graph before falling back to AE2. Range: 1-5000 ms; default: 100 ms.
Logs aggregation timing, merged-node counts, and fallback reasons for the Omni-Computation Core.
Allows compatible providers to extract and dispatch multiple pattern crafts at once. Disabling this falls back to AE2 single-pattern dispatch. Enabled by default.

Allows item-substituting patterns to use batch dispatch. Fluid-only substitution remains deterministic and is allowed by default. Item substitution may conflict with NBT Tear or contextual matching and is disabled by default. Container-returning and reusable inputs still fall back to single-pattern dispatch.

Target dispatch time per Omni-Computation Core and server tick. The scheduler adapts its work-unit allowance from measured cost. Range: 1-20 ms; default: 16 ms. Logical batch size is never reduced by this setting.
Emergency wall-clock limit shared by all Omni-Computation Cores on the server during one tick. Remaining work resumes next tick. Range: 1-50 ms; default: 40 ms.

Maximum adaptive work allowance per Omni-Computation Core and tick. One input extraction and each provider attempt cost one unit, regardless of batch quantity. Range: 64-9223372036854775807; default: 2147483647.
molecularmanipulator.configuration.dynam: Client-side Molecular Center and Omni-Computation Core effects: 0=off, 1=reduced, 2=full orrery and quantum gate. This does not affect crafting speed.
gui.molecularmanipulator.omni.fixed: No expansion or upgrades; full capability when formed
gui.molecularmanipulator.omni.build_tool: Only places missing blocks. Materials come from the player inventory first, then the connected AE network.
gui.molecularmanipulator.omni.dismantle_: Removes structure blocks in batches and keeps the controller. Recovered blocks go to the AE network first, then the player inventory.
gui.molecularmanipulator.omni.projection: Shows the actual expected block model at every exposed missing position. Click again to hide it. Red outlines indicate conflicts.
gui.molecularmanipulator.omni.refresh_to: Immediately checks every structure block and the AE network state.
